title: Dryden Vos
subtitle: I Get All Worked Up
text: On Attack: You may double this unit's power for this attack. If you do, this unit doesn't ready during the next regroup phase.
rules:
Abilities that refer to a card’s power include temporary modifiers.
Dryden Vos doubles whatever his power is when his "On Attack" ability resolves, which includes temporary attack power modifiers like Raid.
